checks.name: page loads with WebGL
32 figures on the board
all figures at rest in the starting position
d4 and d5 fence each other
e4 braces behind its shield against the knight
fencing partners never thrust at the same moment
both partners take a turn to thrust
fencing thrusts stop at the shield face (≤ 3 cm)
e4 takes d5 is accepted by the rules
at the hit the spear tip is at the defender flank (10–25 cm from the body axis)
the hit lands at body height (0.8–1.5 m)
attacker moves without jumps (< 15 cm per frame)
knees stay within 0–140° flexion
bent knees point forward, never backwards
soles do not sink into the board (≥ rest − 2 cm)
pelvis over the feet while standing
after the scene the attacker stands on d5 and the victim is gone
the pawn walks: feet travel with the body
planted feet do not slide (≤ 1 cm per frame)
a legal opening including castling plays through
no page errors

performance.note: Pose solving per figure on this machine; rendering speed depends on the GPU.

scope: Sampled at 30 Hz with a fixed clock. Spear tip and shield face are measured on the skinned model; this is not a physics or continuous collision check. Garment intersections of the pawn model are a separate known limitation.
